summary.text: Rodney Lyons is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 87 (Jefferson Parish), and was elected in 2015, according to the official House member page. Rodney Lyons is vice chair of the House and Governmental Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Rodney Lyons's occupation as Retired Jefferson Parish, Public Works Business Consultant, Leadership Trainer, Licensed Realtor.
It lists education as University of New Orleans; Delgado Community College; John Maxwell Certified Leadership Trainer; American Public Works Association.

The page lists committee assignments including House and Governmental Affairs (vice chair), Appropriations, Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, the House Executive Committee and the Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.
